title: Studio Automations pillar: on a read-only package the header enable switch stays clickable and the flow node inspector stays editable — edits are refused or silently discarded (residual of #2259)
body:
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20674 · studio-authoring.packaged-automation-studio-lock · c3, c4

## What happens

On a read-only package (the showcase's source-loaded `com.example.showcase`, badged Read-only, `GET /api/v1/packages` → `writable: false`), the Automations pillar hides "New" and blocks autosave as intended, but two affordances ignore the read-only flag:

1. **The header "Enabled" switch is clickable.** A click flips it locally and saves a flow draft that the server refuses: `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/showcase_urgent_task_alert?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase` → 403 `ITEM_LOCKED`. The banner shows the server text, but the switch and the canvas status keep showing "Disabled" / "obsolete" until the pillar is reopened.
2. **The flow node inspector is editable.** Its inputs are neither disabled nor read-only; a Label edit takes on the canvas, nothing announces that it will not persist, no write leaves the browser, and the edit is gone after reopening the pillar.

The server gate holds (the flow's metadata was byte-identical before and after). This is the client courtesy gate objectui#2259 fixed for the Data pillar, missing on the Automations pillar.

Measured against objectstack `main` at `6bff748b` with this repo's console built at the pinned `dd3f7e1be356`.

## Reproduction

1. Boot the objectstack showcase; sign in as `admin@objectos.ai`.
2. Open `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/automations?surface=flow%3Ashowcase_urgent_task_alert`.
3. Click the header "Enabled" switch → observe the 403 draft save, the banner, and the switch left in "Disabled".
4. Click the start node; change Label in the Configuration inspector → the canvas shows the new label; wait past the autosave debounce (no write); reopen the pillar → the edit is gone, and it was never announced.

## Mechanism (at `dd3f7e1be356`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`)

- `AutomationsPillar` receives `readOnly` and passes it to "New" and autosave, but the header switch is `disabled={!isEditable || !!saving}` — no `readOnly`.
- The flow inspector is created with `readOnly: false` hardcoded, where the Data pillar threads the real flag.
- `toggleEnabled` sets the draft optimistically and does not roll back on a refused save.

## Expected

On a read-only package the switch is disabled (or absent) and the inspector is read-only (or announces that edits will not persist), matching the `readOnly` contract the pillar documents ("hide/disable flow-authoring affordances").

Full evidence chain: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20674 (F-5).
